abstract: Covers WebMCP, the W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group draft for registering page tools with AI agents through document.modelContext, pinned to the Draft Community Group Report of 30 September 2026 (commit d61d0e6) with a build posture. It lists two version lines: the WebMCP Draft Community Group Report (current, build) and the legacy navigator.modelContext drafts before pull request #184, with an upgrade checklist. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references cover versions and upgrades, the API (WebIDL, registration, execution, discovery, events) and security and privacy (Permissions-Policy, cross-origin exposure, annotations, the draft's risk list).
